Learn more about Upper Cervical Chiropractic in Singapore!

We are nerve system specialists. Vitality Chiropractic, is the ONLY centre in Singapore specialising in migraines, headaches, vertigo, dizziness, and other nerve system problems, using Upper Cervical Specific Chiropractic care.

Vitality Chiropractic is Singapore’s only Upper Cervical Specific Chiropractic centre, being the first to bring this technique to South-East Asia. 

We utilise:
1. Unique x-rays for accurate diagnosis
2. Computed thermography to examine patient’s Nerve System at every appointment
3. First in South-East Asia trained in this Upper Cervical Specific technique
4. Functional Neurology exercises

We specialise in the hardest cases. 
Cure for migraine? Vertigo treatment Singapore? Meniere's disease treatment in Singapore? Neck pain treatment Singapore? Fibromyalgia Singapore? 

Take Your Life Back.
